description: This file defines a package for compiling CEL expressions used in Kubernetes admission plugins, including type definitions for admission requests and namespace objects, and a compiler interface with implementation for creating and managing CEL environments and compiling expressions.

classes.name: CompilationResult
classes.description: Represents a compiled CEL expression, including the program, errors, expression accessor, and output type.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: Interface for a CEL expression compiler configured with admission variables and environment mode.

classes.name: compiler
classes.description: Implementation of the Compiler interface, managing environment variable sets for compilation.

methods.name: BuildRequestType
methods.description: Generates a CEL declaration type for Kubernetes AdmissionRequest.

methods.name: BuildNamespaceType
methods.description: Generates a CEL declaration type for Kubernetes Namespace objects.

methods.name: NewCompiler
methods.description: Creates a new Compiler instance with a given environment set.

methods.name: CompileCELExpression
methods.description: Compiles a CEL expression with specified variable options and environment type, returning a CompilationResult.
